blocks.text: New Houses, Family Homes & MLS Listings in Burke Mountain

parts.t: Burke Mountain homes for sale feature modern detached houses, new construction, and family-friendly neighbourhoods in one of Coquitlam's newer communities. Browse updated MLS® listings with photos, prices, and floorplans near parks, schools, and trails.
Work with local Realtor Jared Gibbons for expert advice and private showings in Burke Mountain.

Burke Mountain represents Coquitlam's premier mountain community, offering stunning views, newer construction, and outdoor lifestyle that attracts active families and professionals. This rapidly developing area features modern homes with contemporary designs, many boasting panoramic vistas of the Fraser Valley, city lights, or surrounding mountains creating spectacular settings. Residents love extensive trail networks for hiking and mountain biking literally from their doorsteps, plus proximity to skiing and mountain recreation.

The community boasts new schools built specifically for the growing population, parks throughout neighbourhoods, and the Village at Burke Mountain providing shopping and dining convenience. Despite the mountain location, the Evergreen SkyTrain extension brings rapid transit connectivity making Vancouver commutes viable. Properties range from townhomes to executive estates, all benefiting from the area's elevation and natural surroundings. Burke Mountain continues developing with high construction standards and thoughtful planning. Ready to explore elevated Coquitlam living?
